name: multistorey-section-f13
description: v0.31.5.383 visual verification: the report's Section A-A on the two-storey Open Loft must show BOTH storeys stacked (it cut the ground floor only), with the upper storey's walls, rooms and furniture at its own elevation.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: load-loft-plan
steps.eval: (function(){ window.__loadErr=null; import('/src/floorplan/templates.ts').then(m => { const plan = m.PLAN_TEMPLATES.find(p => p.id === 'tpl-loft'); if (!plan) throw new Error('tpl-loft missing'); window.__store.getState().replaceFloorPlan(plan, { furniture: 'rehome' }); }).catch(e => { window.__loadErr = String(e); }); })()

steps.name: put-furniture-on-the-loft
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const its=s.items; const picks=its.slice(0,6).map(i=>i.id); const set=new Set(picks); s.setItems(its.map(it => set.has(it.id) ? { ...it, levelId:'lf-up', position:[1.0+picks.indexOf(it.id)*0.7, 4.6] } : it)); })()

steps.name: patch-window-open
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml=null; window.open=function(){ return { document:{ write:function(html){ window.__capturedHtml=html }, close:function(){} }, close:function(){}, focus:function(){}, print:function(){} }; };

waitFor.store: window.__reportErr ? (() => { throw new Error(window.__reportErr) })() : (typeof window.__capturedHtml === 'string' && window.__capturedHtml.length > 0)

steps.name: assert-upper-storey-elevations-present
steps.eval: (function(){ const caps=[...document.querySelectorAll('.elev-fig figcaption')].map(e=>(e.textContent||'').trim()); if(!caps.length) throw new Error('no wall-elevation figures in the report'); const upper=caps.filter(c=>/— Loft/.test(c)); if(!upper.length) throw new Error('no UPPER-storey wall elevation — projectAllElevations enumerated plan.walls (ground only). Captions: '+caps.join(' | ')); window.__elevCaps=caps.join(' | '); const fig=[...document.querySelectorAll('.elev-fig')].find(f=>/— Loft/.test(f.textContent||'')); fig.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()

steps.name: assert-section-shows-two-storeys
steps.eval: (function(){ const wrap=[...document.querySelectorAll('.elev-section')].find(e=>/Section A/.test(e.textContent||'')); if(!wrap) throw new Error('Section A-A block not in the report'); const svg=wrap.querySelector('svg'); if(!svg) throw new Error('Section block has no svg'); const cols=[...svg.querySelectorAll('g.walls rect')]; if(cols.length<3) throw new Error('only '+cols.length+' cut wall columns — a stacked section needs both storeys walls'); const tops=[...new Set(cols.map(r=>Math.round(parseFloat(r.getAttribute('y')))))].sort((a,b)=>a-b); if(tops.length<2) throw new Error('every wall column starts at the same y — the section is still one storey (tops: '+tops.join(',')+')'); const floors=[...new Set([...svg.querySelectorAll('g.floor line')].map(l=>Math.round(parseFloat(l.getAttribute('y1')))))]; if(floors.length<2) throw new Error('only one floor line — the upper storey floor is missing (y: '+floors.join(',')+')'); window.__sectionTops=tops.join(','); window.__sectionFloors=floors.join(','); svg.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()
